4.1.2.3 Function Inhibition Manager
Detection
Different detection mechanisms exist:
 access to the DEM information (polling for the Event attached to
the requested FID with Dem_GetEventStatus
[SWS_Fim_00072], or dump of the event status on startup
[SWS_Fim_00018])
 [SWS_Fim_00021] notification by the DEM by the
Fim_DemTriggerOnEventStatus callout
Reaction
Depending on the implementation, storage of the Event status when a
change is reported by the DEM.
Report
The FIM can be polled by the SWCs with
Fim_GetFunctionPermission [SWS_Fim_00011].
It does not notify the SWCs.
Recovery
